title: Schneider--Beck--Stoll comparison boundary and full-text access hold
question: Does the Schneider--Beck--Stoll n-component vector-model paper provide a directly applicable rigorous theorem for the positive-lambda non-radial R^8 Q3LOCK phase-coexistence claim?
method: Inspect the authoritative APS bibliographic record and abstract at DOI 10.1103/PhysRevB.13.1123.
Attempt the APS full-text endpoint and record the authorization boundary.
Compare only the accessible stated scope with the Q3LOCK DLR, cusp, loop-FKG, infrared and parity-state obligations; do not infer unreported hypotheses.
finding: The accessible primary record describes a critical-property study of an n-component vector structural-transition model and reports quantum suppression effects in selected regimes. The APS full text was authorization-protected during this audit. The accessible material does not supply an inspectable Euclidean Gibbs/DLR, source-cusp, loop-FKG, reflection-positivity or parity-state theorem, so direct applicability and novelty remain unresolved.
decision_reason: A title or abstract cannot certify the exact Hamiltonian, approximation scheme, hypotheses or rigorous conclusion needed for a line-by-line Q3LOCK crosswalk. The safe disposition is comparison-only with a named full-text/specialist gate, not a claim of non-applicability or novelty.
boundary: T0 literature applicability audit; comparison citation only; no theorem promotion, no claim-tier change, no priority statement, no PDF status change.
next_action: Obtain an authorized full-text copy or a signed specialist disposition that identifies the exact theorem scope and checks it against the Q3LOCK Hamiltonian and DLR/cusp interfaces.
non_claims: The paper is not treated as a direct Q3LOCK theorem.
No conclusion is drawn from the APS authorization barrier about mathematical applicability.
No claim is made that the Q3LOCK result is novel or first.
No KMS, ground-state, continuum, cosmology, Sector A or publication conclusion changes.
